## What that covers

Inazria is built on the D&D 5.1 System Reference Document. Rules text, spell descriptions, conditions, and other mechanical material adapted from that document are used under the license named above. Where Inazria's own wording is unclear or incomplete, defer to the SRD 5.1.

## What is original to Inazria

The setting is original work. That includes Azergad and the Realms, the peoples who live there, the Great Pact and the history around it, the primal and civil class architecture, every class context, and the spells marked as Inazrian originals in the [spell compendium](spells/index.md). None of that is drawn from the SRD 5.1.
